toegepas.voor: Party is tevrede met wat hulle sien en ander wil
toegepas.na: Party is tevrede met wat hulle sien, en ander wil
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two main clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses joined by 'en' ('Party is ... en ander wil ...').
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both clauses have their own subject and verb, so the AWS 2017 comma is required.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Rondom jou ouderdom' echoes English 'around your age'; 'omtrent op jou ouderdom' is the natural Afrikaans.
toegepas.fout: 'Rondom jou ouderdom' echoes English 'around your age' and reads stiff.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Omtrent op jou ouderdom' is the natural spoken Afrikaans and keeps the same approximate meaning.

toegepas.voor: Jy groei dalk skielik vinniger en jou skoene
toegepas.na: Jy groei dalk skielik vinniger, en jou skoene
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma between two main clauses joined by 'en'.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses joined by 'en'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Jy groei ...' and 'jou skoene raak ...' each have their own subject and verb.

toegepas.voor: Jy sweet meer as vroeër en die sweet
toegepas.na: Jy sweet meer as vroeër, en die sweet
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma between two main clauses joined by 'en'.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses joined by 'en'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Jy sweet ...' and 'die sweet kan ...' each have their own subject and verb.

toegepas.voor: Puisies kom op jou gesig uit en hare
toegepas.na: Puisies kom op jou gesig uit, en hare
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma between two main clauses joined by 'en'.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses joined by 'en'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Puisies kom ... uit' and 'hare begin ... groei' each have their own subject and verb.

toegepas.voor: By seuns word die stem dieper en dit kan eers kraak
toegepas.na: By seuns word die stem dieper, en dit kan eers kraak
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma between two main clauses joined by 'en'.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between two main clauses joined by 'en'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'die stem word dieper' and 'dit kan eers kraak' each have their own subject and verb.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Avoids the clumsy 'een klas ... een kind' repetition; the meaning is any class.
toegepas.fout: 'In een klas is een kind' repeats 'een' clumsily.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'In 'n klas' reads naturally, and 'sy maat langsaan' still places both children in the same class.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'vorm' on its own is vague; 'liggaamsvorm' says what is meant without adding content.
toegepas.fout: 'vorm' on its own is vague and can also read as 'form' in the sense of performance.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'liggaamsvorm' says exactly what is meant in a body list without adding content.

toegepas.blok: Foto's wat nie alles wys nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: Afrikaans photographs something 'uit' an angle, not 'van' an angle.
toegepas.fout: 'van die beste hoek' copies English 'from the best angle'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Afrikaans views or photographs something 'uit' an angle, and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.blok: Foto's wat nie alles wys nie
toegepas.voor: met iets wat nie werklik so lyk nie
toegepas.na: met iets wat in die werklikheid nie so lyk nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: Clearer: the point is that the real thing does not look like that, not that it 'does not really look so'.
toegepas.fout: 'nie werklik so lyk nie' can be read as the hedge 'does not really look like that'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'in die werklikheid' fixes the intended sense (in reality it does not look like that) without moving it.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'het elkeen idees' is wooden; 'elkeen hulle eie idees' is the natural idiom with the same meaning.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'het elkeen hulle eie idees' is the natural idiom and anticipates, rather than adds to, the next sentence's point that ideas differ.

toegepas.voor: Hulle verander ook oor tyd en baie mense
toegepas.na: Hulle verander ook mettertyd, en baie mense
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'oor tyd' is a calque of 'over time' (use 'mettertyd'), and the two main clauses need the AWS comma before 'en'.
toegepas.fout: 'oor tyd' is a calque of 'over time', and the AWS comma before 'en' between two main clauses is missing.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'mettertyd' is the Afrikaans expression and the comma is required, with no change in meaning.

toegepas.voor: Aanvaarding van jou lyf beteken nie
toegepas.na: Om jou lyf te aanvaar, beteken nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: The abstract noun 'Aanvaarding van' is wooden for Grade 6; the verb form reads naturally.
toegepas.fout: The abstract noun 'Aanvaarding van jou lyf' is wooden for Grade 6.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The verb form 'Om jou lyf te aanvaar' reads naturally, matches the heading's verbs, and keeps the meaning.

laat_vaar.na: om met iemand daaroor te spot
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Standard Afrikaans uses 'spot met iemand' rather than a direct object.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: Transitive 'iemand spot' is normal Afrikaans for teasing someone, so the preposition swap is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.na: Om jou elke dag te was, help
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'wasbeurt' is stiff and suggests laundry; the verb phrase is more natural for Grade 6.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'n Daaglikse wasbeurt' is acceptable Afrikaans, and with change 15 kept it would stack two 'Om ... te ...,' openings in a row.

laat_vaar.voor: Dit beteken jy is goed vir die lyf
laat_vaar.na: Dit beteken dat jy goed is vir die lyf
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Parallels the preceding 'beteken nie dat' sentence and reads more smoothly.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Dit beteken jy is goed vir ...' already reads naturally; adding 'dat' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.voor: met 'n ouer of 'n onderwyser of 'n ander grootmens
laat_vaar.na: met 'n ouer, 'n onderwyser of 'n ander grootmens
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A list of three takes commas with one 'of', not a repeated 'of'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The repeated 'of' is acceptable Afrikaans and lets each trusted adult stand on its own in a help-seeking instruction.

na_skrywer.voor: as die eerste mens nie luister nie
na_skrywer.na: as die eerste persoon nie luister nie
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'die eerste persoon' is the natural phrase for the first person you spoke to.
na_skrywer.fout: 'die eerste mens' can faintly read as 'the first human' rather than the first person you went to.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The wording may be improvable, but it sits in a help-seeking safety instruction (who to tell next), which the writer owns.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Plekke soos televisie, tydskrifte, advertensies en fone waar ons nuus en prente sien.
vlae.rede: The term 'media' is defined in the glossary but never used in the study text; also advertisements and phones are not really 'plekke'. Not changed, as fixing it needs a content decision.
